gold: Drug-induced dermatomyositis secondary to ipilimumab therapy

selector.rationale: Skin symptoms and muscle weakness are consistent with dermatomyositis, despite the lack of inflammatory myositis on biopsy, which may have been affected by corticosteroid treatment

rejected.label: Ipilimumab-induced dermatitis
rejected.why: Limited to skin symptoms, does not explain muscle weakness and other systemic findings

rejected.label: Lupus-like syndrome
rejected.why: Although antinuclear antibody titer is elevated, other findings are more consistent with dermatomyositis
